description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read all three raw input files (oncall_chat.log, ops_channel.jsonl, engineer_notes.txt) plus the metrics CSVs from the 2024-07-15 incident directory. (2) Apply the Jarvis playbook: define measurable success/failure criteria, build a minimal execution path through checkpoints, and record evidence at each checkpoint. (3) Apply ALL quality gates: every claim must trace to specific evidence (deploy hash d4e5f6, pool size halved from 100→50, 26-min duration, SLO breach to 76%, TICK-882x tickets); explicit assumptions/unknowns must be stated (e.g., non-enterprise cart abandonment count unknown); reversible-change preference noted for rollback. (4) Produce incident_timeline.md with EXACTLY the five required output sections: situation summary in ≤5 body lines; top findings ranked by impact (not chronological); action plan split into explicit 'today' and 'this week' sub-sections; risks + mitigations; and a concrete checklist or commands. (5) Each next step must carry a named owner AND an ETA. (6) A fallback plan must be explicitly stated for the primary remediation. The critical traps are: the 5-line hard cap on situation summary (generic agents write paragraphs), the mandatory today/this week split in the action plan (generic agents write flat lists), the owner+ETA requirement on every action item, and the explicit fallback plan requirement.
